name: Nangula
face: Young Herero girl about eight, with warm deep-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, and a bright open smile.
clothing: Traditional Herero-style ankle-length dress in deep red with white lace trim at the neck and sleeves, a matching deep-red horn-shaped otjikaiva headdress, a white apron panel, small gold earrings, and brown leather shoes.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Distinctive horn-shaped red otjikaiva headdress, Victorian-inspired Herero dress silhouette scaled for a child, white lace trim, and a bright smile.
